Application Data.NAME: Telelink Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Telelink Solutions, LLC provides comprehensive answering and telemarketing services, specializing in customer support and lead generation for various industries. Our operations focus on maintaining high standards of compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and CAN-SPAM regulations. We utilize a hybrid workforce model with robust cybersecurity measures in place, including encrypted data storage and secure remote access, ensuring the protection of sensitive customer information. Our team undergoes regular training to adhere to best practices in communication and data handling, minimizing operational risks and enhancing service quality. Additionally, we have implemented thorough monitoring systems to ensure compliance and mitigate potential errors in client communications.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
On 06/15/2022, a data breach incident occurred due to a phishing attack, resulting in unauthorized access to minimal client information. The cost for forensic investigation and data recovery was $3,000. The incident was resolved with no regulatory fines or client lawsuits, and the business has since implemented enhanced cybersecurity measures. Status: Closed.  
On 09/10/2021, a minor slip and fall incident occurred at the office, leading to a claim of $2,000 for medical expenses. The claim was settled with no litigation involved. Status: Closed.
